summary: Run local fleet compatibility alongside tests and clippy in its own kept Cargo target, avoiding relinks of binaries under test; include the extra target in pool size limits, trimming and eviction.

rules.detail: No evidence acceptance or checkpoint rule change.

compatibility.detail: CI_LOCAL_SERIAL=1 keeps sequential stage execution. Fleet compatibility uses a sibling for an explicit target and an ignored target/fleet-compat directory for a plain run.

recovery.detail: Revert the change or set CI_LOCAL_SERIAL=1 to restore sequential stages.
